nodes.name: Basic Extraction Analytics
nodes.description: Installs automated throughput monitoring and predictive calibration across all active extractor yards. Reduces waste cycles and improves output consistency.

nodes.name: Industrial Safety Protocols
nodes.description: Mandates standardized hazard containment procedures and automated shutdown trip lines across all facilities. Reduces the probability of unplanned extraction outages.

nodes.name: Supply Forecast Engine
nodes.description: Deploys a predictive resource flow model across your logistics network. Reduces extractor construction costs by 6% and improves mining yield by 6%.

nodes.name: High-Density Energy Routing
nodes.description: Redesigns power distribution architecture to support a dedicated high-load manufacturing lane. Required for Tier 2 refinery output and advanced material synthesis.

nodes.name: Material Compression I
nodes.description: Applies high-pressure compression staging to raw silicate inputs before refinery processing. Increases yield per cycle without expanding physical footprint.

nodes.name: Nano-Lattice Weaving
nodes.effect: Unlocks Aerogel and Quantum Insulator refinery chains
nodes.description: Licenses nano-scale lattice assembly techniques from the Pan-System Research Compact. Required for Aerogel and Quantum Insulator output from silicate chains.

nodes.name: Containment Physics I
nodes.description: Establishes magnetic confinement field generation standards. Required before Helium-3 can be safely processed into Plasma Conduits at refinery scale.

nodes.name: Exotic Energy Routing
nodes.description: Extends power routing standards to handle exotic-state matter demands. Gate technology for Dark-Matter Capacitor production from processed Helium-3.

nodes.name: Fleet Coordination Matrix
nodes.description: Integrates command-layer coordination software across all vessel classes. Expands the effective fleet size your corporation can sustain in active deployment.

nodes.name: Near-Star Navigation Array
nodes.effect: Enables travel to Alpha Centauri and Barnard's Star
nodes.description: Commissions a calibrated navigation array tuned to the nearest stellar neighbours. Required before any vessel in your fleet can plot an interstellar course to Alpha Centauri or Barnard's Star.

nodes.name: Deep-Star Cartography Suite
nodes.effect: Enables travel to all charted star systems
nodes.description: Deploys a full deep-space cartography suite capable of plotting routes to any charted system within the local stellar neighbourhood. Unlocks Wolf 359, Tau Ceti, Epsilon Eridani, and all future systems.

nodes.name: Assembly & Fabrication Systems
nodes.description: Licenses modular assembly line blueprints from the Pan-System Engineering Bureau. Required before your corporation can construct an Assembly Facility capable of manufacturing units such as mining probes, drones, and defensive platforms.

nodes.name: Asteroid Prospecting Arrays
nodes.description: Deploys long-range mineral scanning arrays and autonomous probe guidance firmware. Enables the Assembly Facility to fabricate Mining Probes for asteroid belt expedition operations.
